args:
# Minesweeper

## 1. Personas & Value Journey
**Player (single persona).** Wants a quick, fair, single-player puzzle session. Needs to:
- See the board, mine counter, and timer at a glance.
- Start a game at a chosen difficulty, reveal cells, flag suspected mines, and learn the outcome clearly.
- Start a new game at any time.

No other personas are implied.

## 2. Presentation & Interaction
Looks like classic Minesweeper: a rectangular grid of uniform grey square tiles with raised bevels; revealed tiles flatten to light grey, with numbers coloured as in the original (1 blue, 2 green, 3 red, and so on). A red flag marks suspected mines. A mine counter and timer sit in a header bar above the grid, with a face or status button to restart.
- **Left-click (tap)** reveals a hidden cell.
- **Right-click (long-press)** cycles hidden → flagged → hidden (question marks not included).
- Revealing a zero-count cell opens its connected empty region automatically.
- Mine counter shows total mines minus flags placed, and may go negative.

## 3. MVP Scope
In scope: one board, three difficulty levels, reveal, flag, win/loss detection, timer, mine counter, restart.
Out of scope: accounts, leaderboards, multiplayer, payments, administration.

## 4. Core Concepts & States
- **Board:** a grid of cells with a fixed size and mine count set by difficulty.
- **Cell:** state is *hidden*, *revealed*, or *flagged*. Revealed cells hold either a mine or an adjacency count (0–8).
- **Mine layout:** fixed when the first cell is revealed, guaranteeing that cell and its neighbours are mine-free.
- **Game session:** *ready* → *in progress* → *won* or *lost*. Elapsed time runs from the first reveal until the session ends.
- **Difficulty:** Beginner (9×9, 10 mines), Intermediate (16×16, 40 mines), Expert (30×16, 99 mines).

## 5. Business Rules & Invariants
- **R1 Adjacency:** each safe cell shows the number of mines among its up to eight neighbours.
- **R2 Zero expansion:** a revealed cell with count 0 reveals all neighbours, recursively.
- **R3 First-click safety:** the first reveal is never a mine, and its neighbours are mine-free.
- **R4 Flagging:** flags may be placed only on hidden cells; flags cannot be revealed and may be removed at any time.
- **R5 Loss:** revealing a mine ends the session as lost; all mines are shown, and wrong flags are marked.
- **R6 Win:** the session is won when every non-mine cell is revealed. Remaining unrevealed mines are auto-flagged.
- **R7 Terminal state:** no reveal or flag changes are accepted after won or lost; only restart is allowed.
- **R8 Timer:** starts on first reveal, stops at win or loss, and is capped at 999 seconds for display.
- **R9 Invalid operations** (acting on revealed cells, after game end, or outside the board) are ignored without changing board or session state.
- **R10 Restart:** starting a new game discards the current board and timer and returns to *ready*.

intent.audience: players who want to play a single-player minesweeper puzzle
intent.primary_goal: Let players clear a minefield by revealing safe cells and flagging mines, with a clear win or loss outcome.
intent.scope_summary: A playable minesweeper game consisting of a grid board, mine placement, cell reveal and flag interaction, and win/loss detection with a game timer and mine counter.
model_focus: Board grid and cell states (hidden, revealed, flagged)
Game session state (in progress, won, lost) and elapsed time
Difficulty settings (grid size and mine count)
assumptions: The game is single-player and runs locally or in a browser without a backend.
Standard minesweeper rules apply, with the first reveal guaranteed safe unless the pitch specifies otherwise.

specs.title: Adjacency count
specs.description: Each safe cell shows the number of mines among its up to eight neighbours.
specs.given_when_then: Given a game with mines placed and a safe cell at a position When the mine layout is fixed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count equals the number of mines in its up to eight neighbouring cells.

specs.title: Zero expansion
specs.description: A revealed cell with count 0 reveals all neighbours, recursively.
specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 in an in-progress game When the player reveals it Then all its neighbouring hidden cells are revealed and any neighbour with count 0 continues the expansion recursively.

specs.title: Zero expansion stops at numbered cells
specs.description: Expansion does not reveal past cells with a non-zero count, and does not reveal flagged cells.
specs.given_when_then: Given a zero-count reveal that reaches a neighbour with count greater than 0 or a flagged neighbour When expansion runs Then that neighbour is revealed only if hidden and not flagged, and expansion does not continue beyond it.

specs.title: First-click safety
specs.description: The first reveal is never a mine, and its neighbours are mine-free; the layout is fixed at that moment.
specs.given_when_then: Given a game in ready status When the first cell is revealed Then mines are placed so that the revealed cell and all its neighbours have has_mine false, and the layout is fixed.

specs.title: Flag placement on hidden cells
specs.description: Flags may be placed only on hidden cells.
specs.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game and a hidden cell When the player flags it Then the cell state becomes flagged and flag_count increases by one; Given a revealed cell When the player flags it Then the board is unchanged.

specs.title: Flag removal
specs.description: Flags may be removed at any time while in progress; flagged cells cannot be revealed.
specs.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell in an in-progress game When the player removes the flag Then the cell returns to hidden and flag_count decreases by one; Given a flagged cell When the player attempts to reveal it Then the cell remains flagged and is not revealed.

specs.title: Right-click cycle
specs.description: Right-click cycles hidden to flagged to hidden; question marks are not included.
specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell When the player right-clicks it Then it becomes flagged; Given a flagged cell When the player right-clicks it Then it becomes hidden; Given a revealed cell When right-clicked Then it is unchanged.

specs.title: Mine counter may go negative
specs.description: Mine counter shows total mines minus flags placed and may be negative.
specs.given_when_then: Given a game with mine_count M and flag_count F When the counter is displayed Then it shows M minus F, including negative values when F exceeds M.

specs.title: Loss on mine reveal
specs.description: Revealing a mine ends the session as lost; all mines are shown and wrong flags are marked.
specs.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game When the player reveals a mine Then status becomes lost, ended_at is set, all mine cells are shown as revealed, and flagged cells without mines are marked as wrong.

specs.title: Win on all safe cells revealed
specs.description: Session is won when every non-mine cell is revealed; remaining unrevealed mines are auto-flagged.
specs.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game When the last non-mine cell is revealed Then status becomes won, ended_at is set, and every unrevealed mine cell becomes flagged.

specs.title: Terminal state rejects changes
specs.description: No reveal or flag changes are accepted after won or lost; only restart is allowed.
specs.given_when_then: Given a game in won or lost status When the player reveals or flags any cell Then the board and status are unchanged; When the player restarts Then a new game is created.

specs.title: Timer starts on first reveal
specs.description: Timer starts on first reveal, not before.
specs.given_when_then: Given a game in ready status When the first cell is revealed Then started_at is set and elapsed time begins; Given a game in ready status When a flag is placed Then the timer does not start.

specs.title: Timer stops at session end
specs.description: Timer stops at win or loss.
specs.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game When the session is won or lost Then elapsed_seconds is fixed at the value at that moment and no longer increases.

specs.title: Timer display cap
specs.description: Timer is capped at 999 seconds for display.
specs.given_when_then: Given elapsed time greater than 999 seconds When the timer is displayed Then it shows 999.

specs.title: Invalid operations ignored
specs.description: Acting on revealed cells, after game end, or outside the board is ignored without changing state.
specs.given_when_then: Given any game state When the player reveals a revealed cell, acts after game end, or targets a position outside the board Then the board and session state are unchanged.

specs.title: Restart resets session
specs.description: Starting a new game discards the current board and timer and returns to ready.
specs.given_when_then: Given a game in any status When the player starts a new game at a chosen difficulty Then a new board is created with status ready, elapsed time zero, and no mine layout fixed.

specs.title: Difficulty grid and mine count
specs.description: Three difficulties define board size and mine count.
specs.given_when_then: Given a player starting a game When Beginner is chosen Then the board is 9x9 with 10 mines; Intermediate yields 16x16 with 40 mines; Expert yields 30x16 with 99 mines.

specs.title: Board edge boundaries
specs.description: Neighbour computation at board edges and corners counts only in-board cells.
specs.given_when_then: Given a cell on the board edge or corner When adjacency is computed Then only neighbours inside the board are counted, giving fewer than eight neighbours.

specs.title: Grid cell presentation
specs.description: Board looks like classic Minesweeper: raised grey hidden tiles, flat light grey revealed tiles, numbers coloured as original (1 blue, 2 green, 3 red).
specs.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell with count 1 When the board is rendered Then the tile is flat light grey and the number is blue.

specs.title: Flag and header presentation
specs.description: Flags render red; the header shows mine counter, timer, and a restart control.
specs.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When rendered Then a red flag is shown; Given a game in progress When the header is rendered Then mine counter, timer and restart button are visible above the grid.
